title: Closing a project fails: 'An object could not be cloned'
notes:
v2.44.0 (from #240): the project close key fails on every project with 'Something broke: An object could not be cloned. — the app is still running, part of it may not be.' (and the same line in the log). Reported by the user closing dotfiles, 2026-11-09.

Cause: close-project.ts askMain sends names: ports.namedPanes(page) over projects:close, and renderer.ts wires namedPanes to the function that returns whole Pane objects ({ ...pane, name }), with the xterm Terminal and DOM element inside. Electron's structured clone refuses them.

Fix: what goes over IPC is PaneName only ({ index, name }). Do the narrowing in close-project.ts (askMain maps to { index, name } before calling closeProject), so it is testable without the DOM, and type the port as returning PaneName[] from a source that cannot hand it a Pane. Add a close-project test with a fake page whose panes carry a function and a non-plain object, asserting the request is structuredClone-able (structuredClone(request) does not throw). Grep the other bridge calls for the same mistake (a renderer object with a terminal or element spread into an IPC request) and fix any found. Docs: projects history line.
